description: Find security reporting channels for responsible vulnerability disclosure. Takes a domain, IP, URL, package name, repository, container image, mobile app, hardware device, browser extension, desktop app, or organization name. Returns bug bounty programs, security.txt contacts, VDP links, abuse contacts, and national/global CERT fallbacks ordered by applicability to the queried owner and asset. This is informational only — not legal advice.

asset.description: The asset to look up. Examples: "disclose.io", "8.8.8.8", "npm:express", "gh:facebook/react", "app:WhatsApp", "hw:Cisco ASA 5505"

asset_type.description: Force a specific asset type. Auto-detected if omitted.
